basic_details.job_title: DHFWS Rampurhat Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.post_name: Staff Nurse (XVFC Health Grants), Staff Nurse (NUHM)
basic_details.short_information: District Health and Family Welfare Samiti, Rampurhat Health District (DHFWS Rampurhat), West Bengal, has invited applications for 5 posts in 2 roles under Advt No. 02/2026-27. The posts include Staff Nurse (XVFC Health Grants), Staff Nurse (NUHM). The online application is open from 13 November 2026 to 26 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online through net banking/ UPI payment or credit/debit card; non-refundable. Last date to pay the fee: 23 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Completed GNM training course from an Institute recognised by the Indian Nursing Council/ West Bengal Nursing Council, or completed B.Sc. Nursing Course; registered under West Bengal Nursing Council; proficiency in local language; permanent resident of West Bengal

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Completed GNM training course from an Institute recognised by the Indian Nursing Council/ West Bengal Nursing Council, or completed B.Sc. Nursing Course; registered under West Bengal Nursing Council; proficiency in local language; permanent resident of West Bengal. Age limit: 21 to 40 years. Pay: Rs. 25,000 ( Rupees Twenty five Thousand Only). Qualification required: Completed GNM training course from an Institute recognised by the Indian Nursing Council/ West Bengal Nursing Council, or completed B.Sc. Nursing Course; registered under West Bengal Nursing Council; proficiency in local language; permanent resident of West Bengal. Age limit: 21 to 40 years. Pay: Rs. 25,000 ( Rupees Twenty five Thousand Only).

how_to_apply: Apply online through www.wbhealth.gov.in; only online applications are accepted.
Pay the fee online using application ID and Date of Birth between 13-11-2026 and 23-11-2026.
After successful payment, re-login for final submission of the application by 26-11-2026.
Upload proper and full signature and photograph; accept the pop-up during registration.
Download and keep the online registration form from https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in; no hard copy is to be sent by post.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026. Applications opened on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 4 Staff Nurse (XVFC Health Grants), 1 Staff Nurse (NUHM).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHFWS Rampurhat Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General Caste: Rs.100. Reserved Category: Rs.50.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Reserved candidates As per govt. norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 25,000 ( Rupees Twenty five Thousand Only) for Staff Nurse (XVFC Health Grants), Rs. 25,000 ( Rupees Twenty five Thousand Only) for Staff Nurse (NUHM).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Completed GNM training course from an Institute recognised by the Indian Nursing Council/ West Bengal Nursing Council, or completed B.Sc. Nursing Course; registered under West Bengal Nursing Council; proficiency in local language; permanent resident of West Bengal. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be registered under West Bengal Nursing Council. Proficiency in local language. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. Should be able to read, write and speak in Bengali.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages of the selection process.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Merit basis in the GNM / B.Sc. Nursing examination. Marks in the score-sheet are calculated after rounding off up to 2 decimal points.
